objective: Propose the Jin Notes Wave-2 Track B (Obsidian-style live note editor) spec: a FRONTEND-ONLY per-block live-preview editor in the (Track-A-shipped) 3-pane Notes detail. Backend save is DONE (editNote -> edit_note -> ops::notes::edit_note + api::refresh; body-only = in-place overwrite, title+folder preserved) — NO Rust/Tauri/schema changes. Add 2 runtime deps (markdown-it@14.2.0 html:false + dompurify@3.4.11) + @types/markdown-it (dev). Single sanitize chokepoint lib/notes/markdown.ts returning a sanitized DocumentFragment (renderMarkdownFragment). Pure lossless fence-aware block transform lib/notes/blocks.ts (serialize(parse(body))===body by partition-concatenation). Per-block live editor lib/notes/editor.ts (rendered HTML idle, raw textarea on focus, blur re-renders + reassembles). Wire into renderNoteDetail (render.ts:199-204) + NotesController autosave-on-blur via editNote({body}) with getNoteById re-fetch reconcile + app:error on failure. Anti-shallow gates: G-SANITIZE (adversarial), G-ROUNDTRIP (property), G-SWAP (live preview), G-SAVE (controller-driven Stimulus). Existing XSS gate (notes_controller.test.ts:486-499) stays green by html:false construction. Deferred: wikilink autocomplete, slash commands, image paste, table editing, task-list checkboxes, keyboard block nav, new-note auto-edit.

Single chokepoint only (G-CHOKEPOINT). NO Rust changes — reuse editNote(id,{body}). Frontend tests need Node >= 20 (nvm v24.18.0).

assumptions: editNote(id,{body}) (body-only) takes the in-place overwrite branch preserving title+folder; edit_note_fn calls api::refresh (invoke.ts:68-78, commands/notes.rs:71-86).
getNoteById reads body_markdown fresh from disk (Wave-1 D3) so re-fetch reflects canonical bytes (invoke.ts:49-51, dto.ts:39-45).
markdown-it html:false escapes raw HTML to literal text so script/img-onerror never become live nodes; DOMPurify is defense-in-depth on rendered HTML.
DOMPurify binds the ambient window (real webview in prod; jsdom in vitest via @vitest-environment jsdom).
